newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Kuok to start condominium sales.
newsitem.headline: Kuok to start condominium sales.

text.p: Kuok Philippine Properties Inc said on Friday it would start selling two high-end condominium projects in Manila.
The condominium project, which sits on 1.2 hectare lot in the commercial district of Cubao, is to be comprised of five 32-storey residential towers.
The company is selling the units for 1.5 million pesos for a two-bedroom unit, 2.2 milion pesos for a three-bedroom unit, and 4.0 million pesos for a split-level unit.
The second project, a 48-storey residential building, the Shang Tower, will be launched soon, the company said in a statement.
The company did not disclose the cost of the two projects.
